distractors.reason: We don't say 'library review'. 'Library' names a place, not the body of published research being summarised.
We don't say 'reading review' as a fixed academic term. 'Reading' describes an activity, not a field of published work.
We don't say 'novel review' for a summary of research. 'Novel review' refers to reviewing a work of fiction.

example_sentence: Before the seminar, we read a short ___ review of recent work on climate policy.
l1_interference: В українській мові залежний іменник зазвичай стоїть після головного (огляд літератури), тому студенти часто ставлять його після слова 'review' і говорять 'review literature' замість 'literature review'.
explanation: In English, the first noun works as a modifier and stays in front of the head noun, so 'literature' describes the kind of review. This is the reverse of the Ukrainian genitive construction.

related_collocations.example: Her research paper was accepted by the journal.
The article went through a strict peer review before publication.
Students post questions on the course discussion forum.

memory_tip: Put the modifying noun first: LITERATURE REVIEW = a review OF literature, the way a BUS STOP is a stop FOR buses.
